ridePage.selectionTitle: Records shown on the map & chart
ridePage.selectionScope: {{count}} of {{total}} records shown · the same selection applies to the map, charts and table.
ridePage.missingMetric: — Unavailable or private · 0 is a recorded value.
ridePage.noRoute: No GPS routes to display. View the selected records in the table below.
ridePage.noElevation: The selected records have no distance and elevation data for this chart.
ridePage.chart.distanceBasis: Distance from each record’s own start
ridePage.chart.distanceHelp: Records are aligned by cumulative distance. Different starts mean equal distances may refer to different times or places. Panels separate metrics; the same color identifies the same activity record.
ridePage.chart.coverage: {{count}} of {{selected}} selected records have distance data
ridePage.chart.noClock: The selected records have no verified clock and elevation data. Switch to distance to view their available data.
ridePage.chart.timeCoverage: {{count}} of {{selected}} selected records have verified clock data
ridePage.chart.timeHelp: Records align by their recorded timestamps. Relative time is added to the start only for Strava records with confirmed seconds. Device clock errors are not corrected; records with missing or uncertain time data are excluded.
ridePage.chart.timeSampleBasis: Nearest recorded sample to the selected time, within 3 typical sample intervals and at most 30 seconds.
ridePage.chart.selectSample: Point at the chart or use arrow keys to select a sample.
ridePage.chart.rangeHint: Drag across a chart from the start to the end of the range to zoom.
ridePage.chart.metricMissing: No recorded sensor data is available.
ridePage.range.timeBasis: Same recorded clock window; each metric averages only its observed time.
ridePage.range.distanceBasis: Each record’s distance window maps to its own clock; these windows may cover different actual times.
ridePage.range.definition: Averages are weighted by observed time between samples. Long gaps and missing values are excluded; the last sample is not extended. Speed includes observed stops and may differ from the whole-activity moving average.
ridePage.range.shortDefinition: Per-metric observed averages; speed includes stops and may differ from whole-activity summaries.
ridePage.map.selectedRange: The map highlights the range currently visible in the chart.
ridePage.chart.samplingNote: Power and speed: interval sample averages · zoom in for detail
ridePage.chart.samplingHelp: Charts show the arithmetic mean of samples within the same horizontal interval, preserving missing data and long gaps. Selected-point values use original samples; grey table averages are calculated separately using observed time weighting.
ridePage.chart.panHint: Drag to pan, or use arrow keys on Pan. Y axes stay fixed to all records.
ridePage.chart.panUnavailable: Select a range to enable panning.
